purpose: Original conifer forest for Grayridge Pass, with a recognizably tapered crown distinct from river oaks.
source_mode: Built-in imagegen original needle-bough atlas plus original authored Blender trunk/branches/canopy; reuse this project's original generated bark source with provenance.
assembly_human_review: root and independent consultant reviewed; user overall art acceptance pending
alpha_policy: Actual generated transparent alpha is retained for needle silhouettes. This 3D foliage texture is an explicit direct-alpha exception: chroma-key would risk erasing thin green needles or leaving colored fringes. Deterministic cutout threshold and color dilation are permitted; no new painted needles.

shape.foliage: Individual bough cards on radial, irregular branching layers; no whole-tree crossed billboard or cone substitute.

integration: Replace the pass map's oak species at existing identical placements and wood-resource sites. River retains oak. Resource quantities, blocked/noBuild grids and road connectivity must remain unchanged.
qa: Needles, cutout alpha and padding checked for fringe, crop and visible card edges
Model reimport, UV/normals, bounds, materials, GLB validator and triangle/file budgets
Full all-direction model visual review and actual RTS-scale capture
Forest instancing/fog and wood-resource harvesting preserve gameplay
Both maps and full Vitest regression plus browser interaction and performance evidence
excluded: No third-party model, stock foliage, rig or animation; no map route redesign in this asset change. Cliffs/river banks/ruins remain separate required map art work.
publication_scope: local working copy only; accepted mid-ground assembly, external deployment not authorized
